module: Quick race (quickrace) loader. It walks the levels (levels/<level>/quickrace/*.json, including .race.json files) and the Track Editor tracks (trackEditor/ folder of the user documents), builds the list of levels and tracks shown by the selection screen, then turns a choice (track, vehicle, race type) into a scenario via scenario_scenariosLoader.processScenarioData and launches it. A quickrace track modder uses it indirectly: their files are read by getTracks.
usage:
-- list the levels that have quickraces and their tracks
local levels = scenario_quickRaceLoader.getQuickraceList()
for _, lvl in ipairs(levels) do
  for _, t in ipairs(lvl.tracks) do log('I', 'x', lvl.levelName .. ' / ' .. t.name) end
end
notes: A track file is a JSON read by getTracks. Fields used: name, difficulty, closed (otherwise lapCount forced to 1), lapCount, defaultLaps (with raceFile), reversible, allowRollingStart, tod (index 0 to 9 to a time of day, default 3), lapConfig, startLineCheckpoint, finishLineCheckpoint, spawnSpheres {standing, standingReverse, rolling, rollingReverse} (default <trackName>_standing_spawn etc.), prefabs / reversePrefabs / forwardPrefabs, luaFile (relative to levels/<level>/quickrace/), startHTML (default quickrace/<trackName>.html), introType (default 'htmlOnly', 'none' without HTML), procedural, flowgraph, classification {closed, allowRollingStart, reversible}.
A file whose extension is 'race.json' is treated as a track based on a race path (raceFile = this file).
The prefabs <trackName>.prefab[.json], <trackName>_reverse.prefab[.json] and <trackName>_forward.prefab[.json] in the quickrace/ folder are added automatically if they exist.
Preview images are <trackName>.jpg and <trackName>_reverse.jpg in the track's folder.
The 'driver_training' level only lists procedural tracks, all other levels only non-procedural tracks. The 'smallgrid' level is renamed "Track Editor Tracks".

Track Editor tracks: a trackEditor/<name>.json file must have a version field, otherwise it is ignored with a message (old format). They are attached to the level trackData.level (default 'smallgrid').

loadQuickrace: reverses lapConfig if trackFile.reverse (and swaps the start and finish checkpoints if the track is not closed), appends finishLineCheckpoint at the end of lapConfig, sets isQuickRace = true and the time of day from the tod array, unless levelInfo.disableQuickraceTimeOfDay.
loadQuickrace modifies the passed tables (scenarioFile, trackFile) in place.
Dead code: mimicProcTracks and getCustomTracks are not exported. In loadQuickrace, scenarioFile.isReverse = false is written twice.
getLevel recomputes the whole level list on every call (expensive), and getLevelTrack depends on it.

quickRaceModules.desc: Extensions loaded when a quickrace starts: scenario_scenarios, statistics_statistics, scenario_waypoints, scenario_quickRace, core_hotlapping.

getLevelList.desc: Returns the list of level names (levels/ folders containing info.json).

returns.desc: Level names; empty list if the levels/ folder does not exist.

getQuickraceList.desc: Builds the list of levels that contain quickraces (JSON files in levels/<level>/quickrace/ or Track Editor tracks). Each entry describes a pseudo-scenario for the UI: levelName, levelInfo, name, previews, tracks, trackCount, vehicles (scenario_player0 player), playersCountRange, etc.

returns.desc: List of level entries with at least one track.

getLevel.desc: Finds a level in the quickrace list by its folder name or title.

getLevelTrack.desc: Finds a track of a level by its name.

customPreviewLoader.desc: Determines the preview images of a level: levelInfo.previews prefixed with the level folder, otherwise the files <level>_preview*.png then .jpg at the level root. Writes levelInfo.directory and levelInfo.previews.

levelInfo.desc: Level entry being built (must have levelInfo.levelInfo).

returns.desc: List of image paths (warning in the log if empty).

getTrackEditorTracks.desc: Reads the user's trackEditor/*.json files and creates a quickrace track for each (name, author, difficulty 37 by default, lapCount depending on connected/defaultLaps, jpg/png preview, spawnSpheres '_standing_spawn' etc., luaFile util/trackBuilder/quickraceSetup).

loadTrackBuilderJSON.desc: Reads a Track Editor track JSON: trackEditor/<name>.json.

originalFilename.desc: Track name without folder or extension.

returns.desc: JSON content, or nil (file missing or unreadable, info message in the log).

getTracks.desc: Parses the quickrace files of a level and returns the list of completed tracks with default values (see notes), sorted by name.

quickraceFiles.desc: Paths of the quickrace JSON files.

lvlName.desc: Level name, used to detect 'driver_training' (procedural tracks).

returns.desc: Tracks, with trackName, directory, previews, spawnSpheres, official, etc.

loadQuickrace.desc: Turns a chosen track and vehicle into a full scenario: fills scenarioFile (track, vehicle, name, lapCount, lapConfig, prefabs, startHTML, introType, isReverse, rollingStart, levelObjects.tod, isQuickRace, quickraceType) then calls scenario_scenariosLoader.processScenarioData.

scenarioFile.desc: Level entry from getQuickraceList, modified in place.

trackFile.desc: Chosen track; track.reverse, track.rollingStart and track.tod are read.

raceType.desc: Race type, stored in quickraceType (inferred from code).

startQuickrace.desc: Starts a quickrace. If a level is already loaded, delays the start until it is unloaded. Otherwise loads the quickRaceModules extensions, the track's luaFile (and util/trackBuilder/splineTrack for a Track Editor track), builds the scenario with loadQuickrace and calls scenario_scenarios.executeScenario.

uiEventStartHotlapping.desc: Called by the UI (hotlapping app): loads core_hotlapping on demand if no scenario is running, then calls core_hotlapping.startHotlapping().

uiHotlappingAppDestroyed.desc: Called by the UI when the hotlapping app is destroyed: unloads core_hotlapping if no scenario is running.
